title: offering a guessed feelings into words for a child
summary: sheet suggests using words, face, and voice to show what you think a 9-month-old feels, for example by saying the child is unhappy and offering comfort.
body: The United States milestone sheet for 9-month activity notes say to use words, facial expressions, and voice to show what you think the child feels, and the feelings it names are unhappy, mad, and glad. The example sentence on the page is telling the child they are unhappy and seeing whether they can be helped to feel better. The note is a suggestion for chatting with a child. It does not say the caregiver's guess is always right, and it is not a mood report about a stranger.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the tip to name a guessed feeling such as sad, mad, or happy and to offer comfort.
